Home Away From Home
Château Villarlong
What truly makes this Château special for your vacation or event is the way it seamlessly combines the grandeur of a historic estate with the warmth of a welcoming home.
The collection of holiday apartments and villas offer not only a stylish escape but also the genuine feeling of belonging – inviting our guests to indulge in the magic that defines this exceptional destination in Southern France.
With our own on-site restaurant and an all local produce buffet breakfast, with eggs to order available, we have all you need right here.

Hospitality
Eat & Drink
Restaurant Le Castèl
In France, unforgettable holiday memories are always paired with an excellent meal and a fine glass of wine.
Our talented chef, Luc Le Meur, and his dedicated team welcome you to Le Castel , our restaurant nestled in a beautifully renovated vaulted cellar or on the terrace. Enjoy a diverse menu crafted with care, complemented by an extensive wine list – the perfect way to savor the magic of the sunset.
More Information
Leisure
Chateau Villarlong
Events & Weddings
Château Villarlong is more than a venue—it’s an unforgettable experience. From soul-stirring concerts and lively parties to insightful conferences, this historic gem offers a versatile and inspiring space for every occasion. The perfect harmony of timeless charm and modern elegance ensures that every event at Château Villarlong becomes an extraordinary affair—creating lasting impressions and cherished memories.
Where dreams become reality. With its romantic ambiance and breathtaking setting, Château Villarlong provides the ideal backdrop for your wedding day. Whether you’re exchanging vows in its historic halls, dancing under the stars during a magical reception, or celebrating with intimate gatherings, Château Villarlong transforms each wedding into a timeless love story.

Nous informons notre aimable clientèle que le restaurant Le Castèl sera fermé du 28 août au 06 octobre 2026 en raison de la préparation de mariages dont nous avons le plaisir de recevoir au château chaque semaine pendant cette période.

We look forward to welcoming you again from Wednesday, October 07, starting at 7:30 PM.
We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you soon.
The Château Villarlong team

Accommodation
Holiday Apartments & Villas – Comfort and Style for 2 to 6 Guests
Our charming collection of holiday apartments and villas comfortably accommodates groups of 2 to 6 people . Most units features a private terrace , spacious king size beds (1.80 x 2.00 m) , and fully equipped kitchens and bathrooms with showers .
For your convenience and comfort, we provide bed linen, towels, pool towels, and bathrobes – everything you need to feel right at home during your stay.

pages.title: Villa Benoué - Château Villarlong - Majestic château in the south of France with 13 flats offering unique and enchanting charm
pages.text:
Villa Benoué - Château Villarlong - Majestic château in the south of France with 13 flats offering unique and enchanting charm
Skip to main content Villa Benoué
Air-Conditioning
2 - 4 Pers.
80m2
1 Level
2 Bedrooms
2 Bathrooms
From 180€ /Night
Villa Benoué is a real gem in the garden on the pool level just below the château and therefore accessible via a staircase. It is detached with large windows overlooking the greenery and the typical Languedoc landscape.  The open-plan living/dining area with kitchenette leads to the cosy bedroom with adjoining bathroom, where you can even enjoy the view of the countryside from the bathtub. Wonderful sun terrace with private pond. Adjacent via a separate entrance is the second bedroom with en-suite bathroom. This is the perfect place to relax!

pages.text:
Villa Mas du Château - Château Villarlong - Majestic château in the south of France with 13 flats offering unique and enchanting charm
Skip to main content Villa Mas du Château
Air-Conditioning
2 - 4 Pers.
90m2
1 Level
2 Bedrooms
2 Bathrooms
From 200€ /Night
This detached, bright and friendly villa is situated on the access road to the château and has a private pool, pretty garden and sun terrace.
The cosy veranda in front of the house provides access to the flat as well as to the pool and garden.
This small villa is characterised by the light that streams in through the many windows. The living/dining area with open-plan kitchen offers wonderful views of the greenery.
From there you can access the two bedrooms, each with an en-suite bathroom.
A little private paradise!
